resources.string: Understand what is in front of you.
SceneLens detects objects and readable text, then explains the image in plain language. Everything happens on your device.
Tap a detected item to inspect it and hear an uncertainty-aware description.
Extract signs, labels, documents, menus, and packaging with on-device OCR.
Likely, possibly, and uncertain results are named instead of presented as facts.
The app has no Internet permission. Images and analysis stay on this device; captures are deleted after analysis.
Hold steady, then capture. Good light improves results.
The photo could not be captured. Try again.
Camera access was not granted. You can still choose a photo from the gallery.
SceneLens uses the camera only when you ask to capture a scene. The image is processed on this device and deleted after analysis.
No items were detected. Try a clearer, brighter image.
This result has high model confidence, but it is still a prediction.
This result is possible. Check the image before relying on it.
This result is uncertain. Move closer, add light, or take another photo.
This is extracted text. OCR did not provide a dependable numeric confidence, so verify important wording.
SceneLens provides visual assistance, not authoritative medical, safety, traffic, or accessibility guidance. Verify important information independently.
